text:
Maria: Heads up — I pushed the new telemetry feeds for runtime: runtime.latency_p95, runtime.latency_p50, kv_cache.hit_rate, batch.effective_size, model.fallback.rate. Dashboard PR: https://git/repo/123. Need alerting thresholds + pager mapping. Oncall should only page for SLO burn or fallback spikes.

Jonah: Quick question on routing — do we page eng-runtime or eng-sre for fallback spikes? prefer SRE for SLO burn.

Neil: My take: if it's SLO burn page eng-sre. If it's model fallback spike (actual model failures) page eng-runtime. Suggest concrete thresholds below.

Sasha: +1. Also watch kv_cache hit-rate drops — that often causes p95 regressions. If hit_rate drops >15% AND p95 rises >200ms -> page.

Kevin: Note: Dedicated customers expect stricter SLOs. Add customer_tier label and escalate to dedicated-oncall when affected.

Maria: Can someone draft minimal alert YAML so I can attach to the dashboard PR? Example I'm thinking of: 

```yaml
groups:
- name: runtime-alerts
  rules:
  - alert: SLOBurnHigh
    expr: increase(slo_burn_total[10m]) / increase(slo_window_total[10m]) > 0.05
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: page
      team: eng-sre
  - alert: ModelFallbackSpike
    expr: increase(model_fallback_rate[2m]) > 0.20
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: page
      team: eng-runtime
  - alert: KVCacheDegraded
    expr: kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.85 and histogram_quantile(0.95, runtime_latency_seconds_bucket) > 0.2
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: ticket
      team: eng-runtime
```

Jonah: LGTM. For pager integration we need PD service keys and routing rules. @oncall-bot can you confirm available services?

oncall-bot: services found — eng-sre-pd, eng-runtime-pd, dedicated-oncall-pd. I can auto-create routing rules if you provide mapping.

Sasha: Please add runbook link in each alert (docs/runbooks/runtime-slos.md). Include a short checklist: check recent deploys, check KV cache pressure, check model-serving logs.

Neil: Also suggest tagging alerts with deploy_id and adding auto-suppression during deploy windows (silence for 15m if deploy in progress) to reduce noise.

Maria: Thanks — I'll update the PR with this YAML, runbook links, and the customer_tier label. Are we agreed on thresholds: SLO burn 5% over 10m for pager, fallback 20% over 2m for pager, kv_cache drop 15% + p95 reg up -> page? final call.

Kevin: Agree. I'll update PagerDuty mappings and escalation policies after the PR merges.

Jonah: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 15-min ops sync tomorrow to walk through routing and run a test fire drill (simulate alerts).

Maria: Great — I'll ping the PR when updated. Thanks all.
